spans.s:
SNUB: perh. पराभवति (भू, c. 1.): v. Also to
chide, censure.

SNUFF (subs.):
I Powdered tobacco^1: नस्यम्,
to take s.:
नस्यं गृह्नाति, Bha.
II Burnt
candle-wick: perh. छत्रम्; दग्धवर्तिः।
[1] Correction submitted by on 20210319. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/53.

SNUFF (v.):
I To inhale, smell: q. v.
II
to take out s.: छत्रम् अपनयति (नी, c. 1.).
S. out: v. To extinguish.

SNUG:
I Compact: q. v.: संहत (f. ता).
II
Secret, retired: q. v.: गूढ (f. ढा).
III
Comfortable, convenient: q. v.

SNUGGLE: संघृष्य शेते (शी, c. 2.): v. To lie
down.

SNUGLY:
I Comfortably: सुखेन।
II Closely:
संघृष्य।
III Secretly: गूढम्।
